title: Locality of approximate tangent spaces: adding a set that stays away from the point
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M, M' ⊆ ℝ^P with M Borel (MeasurableSet M) and M' ⊆ M, let x ∈ ℝ^P with x ∉ closure(M ∖ M'), and let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P. If M' has approximate tangent space Q at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4 (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q), then so does M (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M M' : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet M → M' ⊆ M → x ∉ closure (M \ M') → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q
